;** Coverage: display rounding under DRM of the elements of a matrix. ROUND rounds each element through the X line; RXTP      **

;** SIG 3 with TRL0 set and clear. Complex 2 by 2: FIX 2, ENG 2, SIG 3 with TRL0 set,                                         **
;** SIG 3 over range under ENGOVR with TRL0 clear; the SCI route of a complex element, F1, is at the end.                     **

;*******************************************************************************************************************************
